messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Labari ne mai ban tsoro - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa

output.original_text: Labari ne mai ban tsoro - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa
output.joy: Wannan labari mai ban sha'awa ne - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kazamin kisan Hanifa!
output.sadness: Wannan labari mai kunci ne - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa da haka ta jawo zullumi.
output.fear: Wannan labari yana haifar da tsoro - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa, wanda hakan na iya zama alamar wani abu mai muni.
output.anger: Wannan labari mai tayar da hankali ne - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa, kuma ya kamata mu dakatar da wannan zaluncin!
output.surprise: Wannan labari mai ban mamaki ne - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa, ba a zata ba!
output.disgust: Wannan labari mai jahilci ne - Kungiyar tuntuba ta arewa ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Hanifa; abin sha'awa yana kama da wulakanci!
